about: Corrections to links printed in a 2027 plan brochure, applied by pipeline/validate_extractions.py when it builds data/brochure_facts.json. The verified quote stays as printed; the fact gets a corrected `url` and a `corrected` note (printed text, page, reason) that the app shows. Each entry's `printed` must match the verified quote or the build stops. No correction was checked online (the pipeline makes no network requests).

overrides.reason: Misprinted host: "sharphealtplan.com" (missing h) appears once, in the drug search sentence. The same brochure prints the plan's own site as www.sharphealthplan.com more than 20 times (e.g. page 1, and page 15: www.sharphealthplan.com/findaprovider), so the host is corrected and the printed path is kept.

evidence.quote: Please see our online formulary and drug pricing search tools at the following: www. sharphealtplan.com/search-drug-list.
